post_text:
Day 5/30 — FrozenDictionary<K, V> (.NET & C#)

Spotted a lookup-heavy lookup service thrashing Gen0 GC because it used standard dictionaries for static config.

• **Memory Profile:** Precomputing maps into frozen buckets eliminates internal node allocations completely.
• **CPU Cache:** Flat internal memory arrays improve cache locality during high-frequency requests.
• **Trade-off:** Fast reads come at the cost of slow mutations since adding items requires a rebuild.

Watch out: Avoid freezing dictionaries that undergo frequent runtime writes.
